title: Tor-independent augmentation after tensoring with an A-K-flat complex
statement: Let R,A,B be commutative rings with R-algebra structures on A and B. Assume Tor_i^R(A,B)=0 for every i>0 [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. Let Q be an arbitrary cochain complex of A-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] such that tensoring any acyclic A-complex on the right with Q preserves acyclicity [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. Let F be an R-K-flat cochain complex and f:F -> B[0] a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], where B is restricted along R -> B. Then Q restricted to R tensor_R f is a quasi-isomorphism. Neither F nor Q is assumed bounded. This asserts only the Q-side vertical augmentation, not scalar extension of a resolution map into Q.

proof.text: Choose a bounded-above projective resolution G of B. Its terms are flat, hence G is R-K-flat. Resolve A as well and compare the two finite-diagonal tensor filtrations: H^{-i}(A tensor_R G) is Tor_i^R(A,B), positive homology vanishes, and the degree-zero augmentation is the ordinary tensor identification. Tor independence makes A tensor_R G -> A tensor_R B a quasi-isomorphism over A.

Its cone is acyclic over A. Tensor with Q using its acyclic-tensor hypothesis. Mixed tensor associativity, the signed tensor-cone comparison and symmetry identify the result with the cone of Q tensor_R G -> Q tensor_R B after restriction to R. Thus this augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism.

For the given F, form the homotopy pullback of the quasi-isomorphisms F -> B[0] and G -> B[0], then take a K-flat resolution H of it. The two projections from H are quasi-isomorphisms between R-K-flat complexes. Their tensors with the restricted Q are quasi-isomorphisms by invariance among K-flat resolutions. The augmentation triangles commute up to homotopy, tensor preserves those homotopies, and two-out-of-three transports the computed augmentation from G to F.

theorem tensorAugmentation_quasiIso_of_torIndependent
    {R A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    (hTor : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i →
      IsZero (((CategoryTheory.Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj (ModuleCat.of R A)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of R B)))
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hK : ∀ L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, L.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor L Q (MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (hF : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).kFlat F)
    (f : F ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) (0 : ℤ)).obj
      ((restrictScalars (algebraMap R B)).obj (of B B)))
    (hf : QuasiIso f) :
    QuasiIso ((((restrictScalars (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
      ◁ f)
